name: Window Zones
author: DerJungeHerr
description: A window manager add-on for floating workspaces, with snapping like Windows 11 snap layouts and FancyZones. Drag a window to a screen edge for a half, into a corner for a quarter, or to the top centre for a panel of zones (halves, thirds, quarters, a centre layout for wide screens, full) and the scratchpad. Adds no key bindings.

barWidget.description: Settings for Window Zones. Left click opens them, right click turns snapping on or off.
